async def act(page):
    # Select the first template by clicking the 'Use template' radio button
    await page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").first.click()
    # Wait for the UI to update after template selection
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait 2 seconds for elements to load
    # Fill in the project name as 'web_agent'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name").fill("web_agent")
    # The 'Private' radio is checked by default, so no action needed
    # Click the 'Create project' button to create the repository
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
